children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout
Sigmainfo: Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury
Key Takeaways
Site map consolidation has been addressed with merged maps and a plan to remove redundant maps from Google Search Console, while low crawl rates and 404 errors for images need immediate attention.
Blog content generation is progressing with 8 blogs completed and plans for 7 more, alongside a directive to improve readability scores and update internal images for better visual appeal.
AI-generated content is under manual review for technical accuracy and SEO, with a recommendation to train the AI for region-specific terminology to ensure proper language consistency.
Enhanced tracking of inbound leads via chat and form fills is required, with discussions on standardizing metrics and funnel reporting to better understand user behavior and conversion gaps.
UI/UX updates are planned starting with the ecommerce page and homepage to address outdated design elements and improve lead conversion; a follow-up meeting will be scheduled to gather feedback.
Action Items
Noted that they found critical injection to be significant and observed that users generally did not click on the CTs present on the pages.
Samarpith Rout
Share the question and answer sheet containing the identified Q&A for Sigma Info solutions by the end of today.
to: Shiresha Madhury
Share the Word document containing the Sigma Info blogs (blocks) with all participants.
Provide the final funnel report on inbound lead tracking to the team.
Mukul M
Recrawl the website to identify technical issues (such as 404 image errors and non‐loading call-to-action forms) and share the detailed crawl report via the WhatsApp group.
Make a note to focus on the home page and e-commerce for discussion.
Sandeep Phophaliya
Standardize and set up tracking tools for inbound leads and chat interactions to enable consolidated funnel reporting.
Schedule a meeting with the UI/UX, ecommerce, and development teams to discuss and plan website design improvements, starting with the ecommerce page.
Problem Statement
Multiple sitemaps present with errors; need to merge and remove redundant ones to address 404 issues.
CTA form above the footer is not loading for users, causing potential lead conversion issues.
Crawl and indexing issues: Out of 1,800 submitted pages, only 580 are indexed, with numerous 404 errors on images.
Background
Blog repository update: 8 blogs are ready and an additional 7 blogs will be completed by the end of the week, totaling 15 blogs in the Sigma info blogs document.
Landing page for Project Engineering Services is completed and will go live tomorrow.
Current Workflow
Content is generated by AI and then manually reviewed for readability, SEO, and keyword optimization.
Consideration of using Wordpress plugins (like Ready Mix) to automatically measure readability scores during blog publishing.
Proposed Solution
Merge multiple sitemaps into a single updated sitemap and remove the redundant ones from Google Search Console.
Crawl the website using a tool to identify and fix 404 errors on images and broken links, and resolve duplicate page issues.
Improve the user interface by optimizing CTA forms and updating the homepage and ecommerce pages for better UX.
Alternatives Considered
Standardize the use of SEO tools such as Wordpress plugins or SEMrush to assess content quality and readability.
Technical Tradeoffs
Balancing AI-generated content with manual review to ensure accuracy, readability, and SEO optimization.
Adjusting language for US market context versus local terminology, such as using 'funding' instead of 'disbursement'.
Stakeholder Feedback
Feedback to improve internal visual content and blog readability scores, with a suggestion to revamp creative images.
Emphasis on standardizing SEO tools and tracking inbound leads, including chat performance metrics.
Timeline
Project Engineering Services landing page goes live tomorrow.
Case studies and Q&A document to be shared by today for review.
Website crawl report expected by today after a 3-4 hour crawling process.
Decisions Made
Proceed with merging and updating sitemaps by removing redundant ones in Google Search Console.
Resolve technical issues including CTA form loading, crawl errors, and duplicate pages with immediate action.
Plan to update UI/UX on homepage and ecommerce pages; schedule a meeting with the UI/UX team to discuss improvements.
Open Questions
Determining standardized language and SEO tool implementation for AI-generated content consistency.
Clarification on handling duplicate pages related to LAN code implementation.
How to effectively track inbound leads and chat conversions using funnel reporting and analytics.
Risk
Non-loading CTA forms risk diminished user engagement and conversion opportunities.
Low page indexing (only 30% indexed) risks reduced website traffic and lead generation.
Outdated UI/UX design poses a risk by potentially failing modern user expectations.
Technical Issues Overview
Sitemap management concern: Multiple sitemaps exist with duplicate pages; recommendation to merge into a single updated sitemap for Google Search Console.
Critical issue with the CTA form above the footer not loading for users, as identified via heatmap data, reducing lead generation effectiveness.
Indexing problem: Out of approximately 1,800 submitted pages, only about 580 are indexed (~30%), with 5% of URLs (primarily images) returning 404 errors.
Plan to recrawl the website and analyze error sources using crawling software and possibly Bing Webmaster tools; update SEO tags and improve overall UI/UX for better user experience.
Content Quality Evaluation
Content is AI-generated but manually reviewed by experts for technical accuracy, readability, SEO optimization, and keyword integration.
Recommendation to improve readability scores and enhance internal blog images; suggestion to use standardized tools (e.g., WordPress plugins) for objective measurement.
SEO Insights
Website crawl reveals only 580 out of 1,800 pages are indexed and a high number of image 404 errors exist.
Consider adding Bing Webmaster tool to gain further insights from the US market.
Plan to optimize SEO tags and meta information in line with US market keyword strategies.
User Engagement Analysis
Proposal to track inbound leads and user interactions via segmented funnel reporting; includes monitoring chat engagement through Zoho Chat and measuring conversions from forms.
